errors.console.hidden.description: Opening the developer console while it is turned off. "Settings → Advanced → Show developer features" is the way to the setting: translate it as Settings shows it.

errors.console.notSource.description: Recording a developer console source this window can't read.

errors.console.sourcesList.description: The developer console asked to watch sources in a form Hive doesn't take (a programming error, rarely seen).

errors.dialog.importBenchmark.description: Title of Windows' file picker in Performance → Compare.

errors.dialog.mcpFiles.description: The file type in Windows' file picker for an MCP server. Keep ".json" and ".zip" as they are.

errors.dialog.openWorkspace.description: Title and button of Windows' folder picker for opening a workspace.

errors.file.insideArchive.defaultMessage: Hive opens no files inside .asar archives.
errors.file.insideArchive.description: Refusal to open a file inside an Electron .asar archive. Keep ".asar" as it is.

errors.file.outsideWorkspace.defaultMessage: Hive can only read and write files inside the workspace, and the agents' instruction, memory and skill files.
errors.file.outsideWorkspace.description: Refusal to open or save a file outside what Hive may touch.

errors.hive.cantList.defaultMessage: Git couldn't list the files it tracks in .hive.
errors.hive.cantList.description: Listing the files of .hive that git tracks failed. Keep ".hive" as it is.

errors.hive.noRepo.defaultMessage: No git repository holds this project: exclude .hive in the version control or sync service you use.
errors.hive.noRepo.description: Exclude .hive from git: the project isn't in a git repository. Keep ".hive" as it is.

errors.hive.notIgnored.defaultMessage: Git still doesn't ignore .hive here: a rule in a .gitignore (a line starting with !) may bring it back. Hive doesn't edit .gitignore files.
errors.hive.notIgnored.description: Exclude .hive from git: after excluding it, git still sees it. Keep ".hive", ".gitignore" and "!" as they are.

errors.image.not.description: Copy image: the file isn't an image Hive can read.

errors.lane.required.defaultMessage: Which lane to end is required
errors.lane.required.description: Ending a card loop without saying which (a programming error, rarely seen).

errors.log.gone.defaultMessage: The log isn't there any more: {path}
errors.log.gone.description: Progress panel: a run's log file was deleted or moved. {path} is where it was.

errors.log.none.description: Progress panel: a run's log can't be opened because the run never said where it was.

errors.log.notFullPath.defaultMessage: The run reported its log without a full path: {path}
errors.log.notFullPath.description: Progress panel: a run gave its log as a relative path, which Hive won't open. {path} is that path.

errors.log.notText.defaultMessage: Hive opens only text logs and reports, not {file}: use Show in folder.
errors.log.notText.description: Progress panel: a run's log isn't a text file, so Hive won't open it. {file} is its file name. "Show in folder" is the menu item beside it.

errors.mergeSlot.holdRequired.defaultMessage: Which hold to release is required
errors.mergeSlot.holdRequired.description: Releasing a merge slot without saying which (a programming error, rarely seen).

errors.pref.notProjectPref.description: Refusal of a call to save a per-project view setting that doesn't exist (a programming error, rarely seen).

errors.pref.notValue.description: Refusal of a per-project view setting's value. {pref} is the setting's internal name.

errors.project.removeHow.defaultMessage: Unknown way to remove a project: {how}
errors.project.removeHow.description: Refusal of a call to remove a project in a way that doesn't exist (a programming error, rarely seen). {how} is what it asked for.

errors.project.stopFirst.defaultMessage: Stop the running session before deactivating this project.
errors.project.stopFirst.description: Turning a project off while one of its agents is running.

errors.provider.unknown.description: A call named a coding-agent CLI this version of Hive doesn't know. {provider} is the id it gave.

errors.tips.notChange.description: Refusal of a call to change which tips were seen (a programming error, rarely seen).

errors.workspace.none.description: An action needs an open workspace and this window has none.

errors.workspace.notFound.defaultMessage: The workspace folder {path} can't be found. It may have been moved or deleted, or be on a drive that isn't connected.
errors.workspace.notFound.description: Opening a workspace whose folder isn't there. {path} is the folder.

errors.worktree.notGit.defaultMessage: {path} isn't a git worktree (it has no .git file). Choose the folder the worktree was moved to.
errors.worktree.notGit.description: Repair: the folder chosen as an agent's moved worktree isn't one. {path} is that folder. Keep ".git" as it is.
